This appeal coming on for conciliation this day, the B  following:
 ORDER IA No.2205/2024 has been filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act read with Section 173 of the Motor vehicles Act seeking condonation of delay caused in filing the appeal.
Appeal, as per office report, is barred by 51 days.
Considering the reasons assigned in the application, the same is allowed.
Delay caused in filing the appeal is condoned.

Parties have agreed to enhance the compensation amount by a further sum of Rs.2,40,000/-
(Rupees Two Lacs Forty Thousands Only).
The other conditions of the award passed by the Claims Tribunal shall be applicable.

Let the enhanced compensation amount be paid within a period of two months from today, failing which enhanced amount shall carry the further interest @ 6% per annum from the date it becomes due, i.e. from 11/7/2024, till payment is received.
As the matter has been settled in Lok Adalat, therefore, the appellant(s) shall be entitled for refund of Court fees.
The appeal is finally disposed of.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR-IV) (SMT. NID  MEMBER MEM  Arun*
